text:
Predicates:
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League research university.
Moved(x, y) ::: x moved to y.
ValuedAt(x, y) ::: x is valued at y dollars.
OrganizedInto(x, y) ::: x is organized into y.
ResidentialCollege(x) ::: x is a residential college at Yale University.
College(x, y) ::: x is a college at y.
Premises:
IvyLeague(yale) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
Moved(yale, newHaven1716) ::: Yale University moved to New Haven in 1716.
ValuedAt(endowmentYale, 42.3billion) ::: Yale university's endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
OrganizedInto(yale, collegesAndSchools) ∧ College(residentialColleges, collegesAndSchools) ∧ College(yaleGraduateSchoolOfArtsAndSciences, collegesAndSchools) ∧ College(professionalSchools, collegesAndSchools) ::: Yale University has been organized into 27 constituent colleges and schools: the residential colleges, the Yale Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, and twelve professional schools.
College(pierson, residentialColleges) ∧ College(benjaminFranklin, residentialColleges) ∧ College(berkeley, residentialColleges) ∧ College(branford, residentialColleges) ∧ College(davenport, residentialColleges) ∧ College(ezraStiles, residentialColleges) ∧ College(graceHopper, residentialColleges) ∧ College(jonathanEdwards, residentialColleges) ∧ College(morse, residentialColleges) ∧ College(pauliMurray, residentialColleges) ∧ College(pierson, residentialColleges) ∧ College(saybrook, residentialColleges) ∧ College(silliman, residentialColleges) ∧ College(timothyDwight, residentialColleges) ∧ College(trumbull, residentialColleges) ::: A list of residential colleges at Yale: Benjamin Franklin College, Berkeley College, Branford College, Davenport College, Ezra Stiles College, Grace Hopper College, Jonathan Edwards College, Morse College, Pauli Murray College, Pierson College, Saybrook College, Silliman College, Timothy Dwight College, and Trumbull College.
Conclusion:
ResidentialCollege(pierson) ::: Pierson College is a residential college at Yale.
